CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD(Date_of_Performance__c - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7), 0, Date_of_Performance__c - 7 - FLOOR((5 + 7 - 1) / 5) * 2, 1, Date_of_Performance__c - 7 - FLOOR((6 + 7) / 5) * 2, 2, Date_of_Performance__c - 7 - FLOOR((0 + 7) / 5) * 2, 3, Date_of_Performance__c - 7 - FLOOR((1 + 7) / 5) * 2, 4, Date_of_Performance__c - 7 - FLOOR((2 + 7) / 5) * 2, 5, Date_of_Performance__c - 7 - FLOOR((3 + 7) / 5) * 2, 6, Date_of_Performance__c - IF(7 > 0, 1, 0) - 7 - FLOOR((4 + 7) / 5) * 2, null )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Balance is due 7 Business Days before the Performance
CustomField.label: Balance due by
